results.description:
Rediscover this classic friends-to-lovers romance from #1 New York Times bestselling author Debbie Macomber.

Jessica Kellerman takes a job as an assistant in the Dryden law firm working for her childhood neighbors, brothers Evan and Damian. But the ghost of Jessica’s teenage crush on Evan haunts her in the professional setting. Not risking any distractions, Jessica makes her job her highest priority, but the long hours and close proximity in the office bring back familiar feelings—except this time, she falls for Damian.

But as Damian is convinced she loves Evan, Jessica must decide if she wants to keep her feelings to herself or risk their professional relationship by confessing her love—and possibly gaining the future she always dreamed of having.

Also by Debbie Macomber: Those Christmas Angels Undercover Dreamer A Girl Like Janet Heartsong
